skill.displayName: Mermaid Charts 全图表画图技能
skill.summary: 使用 Mermaid 语法生成流程图、时序图、类图等多种图表，支持输出 PNG 和交互型 HTML 格式。

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: 15 chart types (flowchart/sequence/class/state/ER/gantt/pie/mindmap/timeline/git/sankey/xy/block/quadrant/journey), PNG+HTML dual output, layout anti-pattern rules, CJK support
